beats.text: Episode 1: why distributed systems are hard.
beats.zh: 第 1 集：分布式系统难在哪。

beats.text: A distributed system is one job done by several computers that talk over a network.
beats.zh: 分布式系统，就是几台通过网络通信的计算机一起完成一件事。

beats.text: We'll take one small job, counting words in eight books, and try to spread it across machines.
beats.zh: 我们拿一个小任务——数八本书里的词——试着把它分到多台机器上。

beats.text: By the end, you'll know your way around src/, and which files are yours to write.
beats.zh: 看完这一集，你能在 src/ 里认路，也知道哪些文件归你写。

beats.text: Here is the whole episode in two sentences.
beats.zh: 先用两句话说完这一集。

beats.text: One machine counts our eight books in a fraction of a second.
beats.zh: 一台机器数完八本书，只要零点几秒。

beats.text: Many machines are how the job scales, and they bring four problems one process never has.
beats.zh: 要扩大规模就得用很多台机器，而它们带来四个单进程里从来没有的难题。

beats.text: Now the page. A, on top: one process. Read the books, Map, sort, Reduce, one output file.
beats.zh: 下面是这张图。顶上 A：一个进程。读书、Map、排序、Reduce、一个输出文件。

beats.text: B, below: the same steps, spread over machines that pass messages.
beats.zh: 下面 B：同样的步骤，分到几台互相发消息的机器上。

beats.text: Marker 1: a machine can die halfway.
beats.zh: 标记 1：一台机器可能做到一半就死了。

beats.text: Marker 2: two machines can write the same file at once.
beats.zh: 标记 2：两台机器可能同时写同一个文件。

beats.text: Marker 3: a message can vanish, and the sender can't tell what happened.
beats.zh: 标记 3：一条消息可能消失，发的人分不清发生了什么。

beats.text: Marker 4: copies of the one record that matters must agree.
beats.zh: 标记 4：那份最重要的记录，各个副本必须一致。

beats.text: And on the right, the five labs. Each one fights one or more of these markers.
beats.zh: 右边是五个 Lab，每个都在对付其中一个或几个标记。

beats.text: Start with the version that needs no network at all: mrsequential.go.
beats.zh: 先看完全不用网络的版本：mrsequential.go。

beats.text: The lab hands it to you as the reference answer. It runs everything in one process.
beats.zh: Lab 把它作为参考答案发给你，所有事都在一个进程里做完。

beats.text: The counting logic lives in a plugin, wc.go: a file of Map and Reduce functions loaded at run time.
beats.zh: 计数逻辑在插件 wc.go 里：一个装着 Map 和 Reduce 函数、运行时才加载的文件。

beats.text: Map gets one book's text. It splits on anything that isn't a letter.
beats.zh: Map 拿到一本书的全文，在所有非字母处切开。

beats.text: It emits one pair per word: the word, and "1".
beats.zh: 每个词吐出一对：这个词，和 "1"。

beats.text: mrsequential loops over the files and appends every pair to one slice, intermediate.
beats.zh: mrsequential 逐个文件读，把所有词对追加进同一个切片 intermediate。

beats.text: Then it sorts that slice by key, so equal words sit next to each other.
beats.zh: 然后按键排序，相同的词就挨在一起。

beats.text: For each run of equal keys it calls Reduce, which in wc.go just counts the values.
beats.zh: 每一段相同的键调用一次 Reduce；wc.go 里的 Reduce 只是数一下有几个值。

beats.text: Each result becomes one line of mr-out-0: the word, a space, the count.
beats.zh: 每个结果写成 mr-out-0 的一行：词、空格、次数。

beats.text: Here is the real run on the eight books in src/main.
beats.zh: 这是在 src/main 那八本书上的真实运行。

beats.text: 3.3 megabytes of text. 623,948 words. 22,107 different ones.
beats.zh: 3.3 MB 文本，623,948 个词，其中 22,107 个不同的词。

beats.text: The top word is "the", 29,748 times.
beats.zh: 最多的是 "the"，29,748 次。

beats.text: And the whole job takes a fraction of a second on one laptop.
beats.zh: 整个任务在一台笔记本上只要零点几秒。

beats.text: So, a fair question: why would anyone use more than one machine?
beats.zh: 那么问题来了：为什么还要用不止一台机器？

beats.text: Because real inputs are not 3.3 megabytes. Google's were terabytes.
beats.zh: 因为真实的输入不是 3.3 MB。Google 的输入是 TB 级。

beats.text: Scale our run by hand: one terabyte is about 300,000 times bigger.
beats.zh: 按比例手算一下：1 TB 大约是它的 30 万倍。

beats.text: At the same speed, that's over ten hours on one machine. Worked out, not measured.
beats.zh: 按同样的速度，一台机器要超过十个小时。这是推算，不是实测。

beats.text: Worse: mrsequential keeps every pair in memory. A terabyte of pairs won't fit.
beats.zh: 更糟的是：mrsequential 把所有词对放在内存里，1 TB 的词对根本装不下。

beats.text: The MapReduce paper reports a grep over one terabyte on about 1,800 machines, in about 150 seconds.
beats.zh: MapReduce 论文报告：在约 1800 台机器上 grep 1 TB 数据，用时约 150 秒。

beats.text: That's the goal: speed from many machines. Now let's see what it costs.
beats.zh: 这就是目标：靠很多台机器换速度。下面看看要付出什么代价。

scenes.title: Two Machines Share Nothing
scenes.zh: 两台机器什么都不共享

beats.text: First, the one fact that makes everything else hard.
beats.zh: 先说一个让后面一切都变难的事实。

beats.text: Two machines, A and B. Each has its own memory. B cannot read A's slice.
beats.zh: 两台机器 A 和 B，各有各的内存。B 读不到 A 的切片。

beats.text: The only link between them is the network. All they can do is send messages.
beats.zh: 它们之间唯一的联系是网络，能做的只有发消息。

beats.text: So A asks B for work the way a program calls a function, except the call travels as a message.
beats.zh: 所以 A 让 B 干活，就像程序调用一个函数，只不过这次调用是作为一条消息发出去的。

beats.text: That's a remote procedure call, RPC: send the arguments, wait for a reply message.
beats.zh: 这叫远程过程调用，RPC：把参数发过去，等一条回复消息。

beats.text: In one process, a call always returns. Across a network, the reply might never come.
beats.zh: 在一个进程里，调用总会返回；跨网络时，回复可能永远不来。

beats.text: Hold on to that. All four markers grow out of it.
beats.zh: 记住这一点，四个标记都从这里长出来。

beats.text: The obvious plan: one coordinator hands out books, workers count them.
beats.zh: 最直接的方案：一个协调者分发书，几个 worker 去数。

beats.text: The coordinator is the machine that holds the to-do list and hands out tasks.
beats.zh: 协调者就是手里拿着任务清单、负责分活的那台机器。

beats.text: A worker is a machine that asks for a task, does it, and reports back, all by RPC.
beats.zh: worker 是来要任务、做完、再回报的机器，全都通过 RPC。

beats.text: Eight books, so eight map tasks, spread over a few workers.
beats.zh: 八本书，就是八个 map 任务，分给几个 worker。

beats.text: On paper, this is just mrsequential's loop with the iterations on different machines.
beats.zh: 纸面上，这就是把 mrsequential 的循环拆到不同机器上跑。

beats.text: In practice, every marker on our page now becomes possible. One at a time.
beats.zh: 实际上，图上的每个标记现在都可能发生。一个一个来。

beats.text: Worker 2 is halfway through Frankenstein, and its machine loses power.
beats.zh: worker 2 数《弗兰肯斯坦》数到一半，机器断电了。

beats.text: In one process, a crash ends everything, so there's nothing half-done to clean up.
beats.zh: 在单进程里，一崩就全没了，不存在“做了一半”的状态。

beats.text: Here, the other seven books are fine. Only this task is lost.
beats.zh: 这里，另外七本书没事，只丢了这一个任务。

beats.text: Toy: the coordinator watches a clock. Worker 2 has been quiet for a while. Is it dead?
beats.zh: 玩具例子：协调者盯着一个钟，worker 2 已经好一阵没动静了。它死了吗？

beats.text: It can't know. A dead worker and a slow worker send exactly the same thing: nothing.
beats.zh: 它没法知道。死掉的 worker 和慢的 worker 发来的东西一模一样：什么都没有。

beats.text: The Lab 1 tests make both happen on purpose, with a plugin called crash.go.
beats.zh: Lab 1 的测试故意让这两种情况都发生，用的是一个叫 crash.go 的插件。

beats.text: It kills a third of its Map and Reduce calls, and stalls another third for up to 10 seconds.
beats.zh: 它让三分之一的 Map / Reduce 调用直接退出，另外三分之一卡住最多 10 秒。

beats.text: How the coordinator recovers is episode 3.
beats.zh: 协调者怎么恢复，第 3 集讲。

scenes.title: 2 · Two Writers, One File
scenes.zh: 难题 2 · 两个人写同一个文件

beats.text: Say the coordinator gives up on worker 2 and hands Frankenstein to worker 3.
beats.zh: 假设协调者放弃了 worker 2，把《弗兰肯斯坦》交给 worker 3。

beats.text: But worker 2 was only slow, not dead. Now both are counting the same book.
beats.zh: 可 worker 2 只是慢，没有死。现在两个人在数同一本书。

beats.text: Both write the same output file, at the same time.
beats.zh: 两个人同时写同一个输出文件。

beats.text: A reader could see half of one and half of the other: "Frankenstein" counted 30 times, or 60, or 17.
beats.zh: 读的人可能看到一半来自这个、一半来自那个：“Frankenstein”可能数成 30、60，或者 17。

beats.text: That's concurrency: two things running at once, touching the same data.
beats.zh: 这就是并发：两件事同时进行，碰同一份数据。

beats.text: Inside one machine, the same thing happens between threads, and Go's race detector catches it.
beats.zh: 在一台机器内部，线程之间也会这样，Go 的竞争检测器能抓到。

beats.text: Atomic rename is episode 3; locks and races are episode 4.
beats.zh: 原子改名在第 3 集讲，锁和竞争在第 4 集讲。

beats.text: Back to our RPC. Every step so far is a message, and messages can be lost.
beats.zh: 回到 RPC。到目前为止每一步都是一条消息，而消息会丢。

beats.text: The labs simulate the network with labrpc, a fake network inside one process.
beats.zh: Lab 用 labrpc 模拟网络：一个进程里的“假网络”。

beats.text: Call sends a request and returns true only if a reply came back.
beats.zh: Call 发出请求，只有收到回复才返回 true。

beats.text: In unreliable mode, processReq, which delivers each request, drops it 10% of the time.
beats.zh: 在不可靠模式下，负责投递请求的 processReq 有 10% 的概率丢掉它。

beats.text: And after the handler has run, it drops the reply another 10% of the time.
beats.zh: 处理函数执行完以后，它还会再以 10% 的概率丢掉回复。

beats.text: Both cases end the same way: Call returns false.
beats.zh: 两种情况的结局一样：Call 返回 false。

beats.text: So when you see false, did the server do the work or not?
beats.zh: 所以看到 false 时，服务器到底做了没有？

beats.text: You can't tell. That one fact shapes the whole KV lab, episodes 5 and 8.
beats.zh: 你分不出来。这一个事实决定了整个 KV Lab 的设计，第 5 集和第 8 集讲。

beats.text: So far, on our page: band A has no markers. Nothing on it can half-fail.
beats.zh: 到目前为止，在这张图上：A 带没有标记，那上面没有什么会“坏一半”。

beats.text: Band B has three already: a dead worker, two writers, a lost message.
beats.zh: B 带已经有三个了：死掉的 worker、两个写的人、丢掉的消息。

beats.text: All three come from one fact: machines share nothing and only send messages.
beats.zh: 三个都来自同一个事实：机器之间什么都不共享，只能发消息。

beats.text: One marker left, and it's about the coordinator itself.
beats.zh: 还剩一个标记，关于协调者本身。

beats.text: Workers can be replaced. The coordinator can't: it holds the only record of which tasks are done.
beats.zh: worker 可以换人，协调者不行：只有它记着哪些任务做完了。

beats.text: The natural fix: keep a copy of that record on three machines. Each copy is a replica.
beats.zh: 自然的办法是把这份记录在三台机器上各存一份。每一份叫一个副本。

beats.text: Toy: three notebooks. One says "task 6 done". The other two never heard. Which one is right?
beats.zh: 玩具例子：三本笔记本。一本写着“任务 6 做完了”，另外两本没收到。哪本是对的？

beats.text: Nobody can say, so the copies must agree on every entry, even while machines crash and messages get lost.
beats.zh: 谁也说不清，所以副本必须对每一条都达成一致，哪怕机器在崩、消息在丢。

beats.text: Now cut the network between notebook one and the other two. Both sides keep working.
beats.zh: 现在把第一本和另外两本之间的网络切断。两边都还在工作。

beats.text: They must not both think they're in charge, or the record splits in two.
beats.zh: 两边不能都以为自己说了算，否则记录就分裂成两份。

beats.text: Getting copies to agree like this is called consensus: Paxos in episodes 13 and 14, Raft from episode 15.
beats.zh: 让副本这样达成一致，叫做共识：Paxos 在第 13、14 集，Raft 从第 15 集开始。

scenes.title: Five Labs on One Board
scenes.zh: 五个 Lab 对上这块板子

beats.text: Lab 1, MapReduce, is the job we just split: markers 1 and 2, crashed workers and duplicate writers.
beats.zh: Lab 1 MapReduce 就是刚才拆开的任务：标记 1 和 2，worker 崩溃、重复写入。

beats.text: Lab 2, a key-value server, lives entirely in marker 3: what to do when Call says false.
beats.zh: Lab 2 键值服务器整个都在标记 3 里：Call 返回 false 时该怎么办。

beats.text: Lab 3, Raft, is marker 4: replicas that agree despite crashes and lost messages.
beats.zh: Lab 3 Raft 是标记 4：机器崩、消息丢，副本照样一致。

beats.text: Lab 4 puts the key-value service on top of Raft, so it survives crashes.
beats.zh: Lab 4 把键值服务放到 Raft 上，让它挺过崩溃。

beats.text: Lab 5 shards it across groups, to win back the speed we started for.
beats.zh: Lab 5 把它分片到多个组，把最初想要的速度赢回来。

beats.text: Everything lives in src/. Some folders are given to you; you never edit them.
beats.zh: 所有代码都在 src/ 里。有些目录是发给你的，你不用改。

beats.text: labrpc is the fake network. tester1 runs your servers, crashes them and checks them.
beats.zh: labrpc 是假网络。tester1 负责启动、弄崩、检查你的服务器。

beats.text: mrapps holds the plugins, like wc.go. main holds the books and the little launchers.
beats.zh: mrapps 放插件，比如 wc.go；main 放那几本书和启动程序。

beats.text: Your files are the ones with comments like "Your code here". There are ten of them.
beats.zh: 你要写的文件，就是带着 "Your code here" 这类注释的那些，一共十个。

beats.text: For Lab 1, that's mr/coordinator.go and mr/worker.go. Right now MakeCoordinator only starts its RPC server.
beats.zh: Lab 1 是 mr/coordinator.go 和 mr/worker.go。现在 MakeCoordinator 只启动了 RPC 服务，别的都要你写。

beats.text: make mr builds the launchers and the plugins, then runs the Lab 1 tests with the race detector on.
beats.zh: make mr 会编译启动程序和插件，然后打开竞争检测器跑 Lab 1 的测试。

beats.text: One: one machine does our eight books in a fraction of a second. We distribute for scale, not for small jobs.
beats.zh: 一：一台机器零点几秒数完八本书。分布式是为了规模，不是为了小任务。

beats.text: Two: the price is four markers: failure, concurrency, an unreliable network, agreement.
beats.zh: 二：代价是四个标记：故障、并发、不可靠的网络、一致。

beats.text: Three: a false from Call can mean "never ran" or "ran, reply lost". Design for both.
beats.zh: 三：Call 返回 false 可能是“没执行”，也可能是“执行了但回复丢了”。两种都要考虑。

beats.text: Build wc.so and run mrsequential on the eight books yourself.
beats.zh: 自己编译 wc.so，在八本书上跑一遍 mrsequential。

beats.text: Before you look: how many times does "Sherlock" appear?
beats.zh: 先别看："Sherlock" 出现了几次？

beats.text: 97. Grep mr-out-0 to check. Next episode: the MapReduce model, one bucket at a time.
beats.zh: 97 次。grep 一下 mr-out-0 就能核对。下一集：MapReduce 模型，一个桶一个桶地看。
